name: SourceRelation_C
definition: SourceRelation_C(C, r, x_r) iff DeclaredContext(C) and TypedSourceRelation_C(C, r) and WellFormedSourceRelation_C(C, r) and ValidSourceRealization_C(C, r, x_r) and Defined(SourceRelationSem_C(C, r, x_r)) and SourceLocal_C(SourceRelationSem_C(C, r, x_r), C, r, x_r).

semantic_record.restriction: Every field must be recoverable exclusively from C, r, and x_r before projection.

blocked_implications: SourceRelation_C does not imply project_w success.
SourceRelation_C does not imply relation preservation.
SourceRelation_C does not discharge OBL-D-001D or OBL-D-001E.
